preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)
Attacker must hold some TeaToken balance to demonstrate the fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() with extremely high values (e.g., 99 each). Then perform a token transfer to trigger the fee mechanism. The high fees will cause most of the transferred amount to be taken as fees, with liquidity fees accumulating in the contract and potentially extractable by the owner through swapAndLiquify mechanism. The owner can also exclude themselves from fees using excludeFromFee() to avoid paying fees while others suffer.
